correctness.rationale: Local backward-pair maps T0=(0,2,3,3), T1=(2,0,1,1) reconstruct each same-period input iff their cyclic composition fixes a pair. Newton sums of t^3-t^2-2 establish b_n=(s_n+1-2*1_{3|n})/2 and its dominant-root asymptotics. Finite direct ring counts through n<=17 are diagnostic only; n=1,2 repeat-neighbor boundaries explicitly covered.
